body.label: Trigger
body.html: An area effect is declared that includes your space.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 2 units toward the nearest edge of the area. If you leave the area, gain +1 Defense against the triggering Action.

surges.html: Any movement from this Reaction ignores Reactions caused by leaving reach or cover.
Draw, conceal, or interact with one small item as part of this Reaction.
